description: Adapter-facing observation batch consumed by the playlist-link-extraction reusable core. Adapters emit observations; the core owns normalization, occurrence ordering, uniqueness, and canonical artifacts.
notes: JSON is the machine-readable authority for adapter input into the core.
adapter_data may hold provider-specific namespaced facts; it must not redefine core identity fields.
Cookies, tokens, browser profiles, and session state must never appear in tracked batches.
